items.q: Should I use Odoo Community or Enterprise edition?
items.a: Odoo Community is free and covers around 80% of SMB needs. Enterprise adds Studio, official support and some advanced modules. We give honest advice based on your specific requirements - most of our SMB clients start on Community and upgrade only when they hit a real need.

items.q: How long does an Odoo implementation take?

items.q: Do you provide GST e-invoicing and Indian compliance in Odoo?
items.a: Yes. We configure Odoo's Indian localisation (l10n_in) modules for GST, e-invoicing and e-way bills, and integrate Indian payment gateways - so your Odoo is compliant from day one.

items.q: Do you provide Odoo training and ongoing support?
items.a: Yes. Every implementation includes team training and written SOPs. We also offer ongoing support and AMC retainers covering maintenance, updates and new requirements.

faq.title: Web development in Ahmedabad: questions answered.

items.q: How much does a website cost in Ahmedabad?
items.a: The cost depends on scope: a 5-page business site, an e-commerce store with payment gateway and a custom web application are very different builds. We share a fixed INR quote with GST invoice within 24 hours of your enquiry.

items.q: Which is the best web development company in Ahmedabad?
items.a: Insta Biz Web is consistently rated among the top web development companies in Ahmedabad with 145+ clients, a 4.9/5 average rating, and 50+ delivered projects. We are based in Naranpura, Ahmedabad and serve clients across Gujarat, India and overseas.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a website?
items.a: A standard 5-7 page business website takes 2-4 weeks. E-commerce stores take 4-6 weeks. Custom web applications and SaaS dashboards take 8-14 weeks depending on scope. We share a precise timeline before kickoff and stick to it.

items.q: Do you provide GST invoice and Indian payment options?
items.a: Yes. All our quotes include GST and we provide a tax invoice with every payment. You can pay via UPI, NEFT/RTGS, net banking, or credit card, split into 3 milestones (kickoff, midway, launch).

items.q: Will my website rank on Google?
items.a: Every site we build is SEO-ready from day one: fast loading (Lighthouse 95+), schema markup, semantic HTML, sitemap, robots.txt, OG images, and Core Web Vitals optimised.

items.q: Can I meet your team in person at your Ahmedabad office?
items.a: Absolutely. Our headquarters is at 219, Swanik Arcade, Opp. Vardan Tower, Pragati Nagar to KK Nagar Road, Naranpura, Ahmedabad. Walk-ins are welcome on weekdays between 10 AM and 7 PM, but a quick call ahead helps us prepare.

items.q: Do you also offer mobile app development and business automation?
items.a: Yes. We are a full-stack digital partner: web development, mobile apps (iOS/Android), AI agents, CRM/ERP systems and business automation. One team, one point of contact, one accountable partner.

items.q: Will I get the source code of my website?
items.a: Yes, 100%. You own the source code, design files, domain, hosting and all credentials from day one. We never lock clients in. If you ever decide to move to another developer, your handover is instant.

items.q: Do you build websites for small businesses and startups in Ahmedabad?
items.a: Yes - small businesses and startups are our core clientele. We have built websites for 145+ SMBs across Ahmedabad and Gujarat: manufacturers, clinics, jewellers, coaching institutes, real-estate builders and D2C brands. Every project gets a fixed INR quote shaped around SMB budgets.

items.q: Which is the cheapest web development company in Ahmedabad?
items.a: The cheapest option is rarely the most economical. Very low quotes usually mean templated work, no SEO, slow performance, and expensive rebuilds within a year. Insta Biz Web offers a fair fixed quote with senior engineers, Lighthouse 95+ performance, full code ownership and 30 days free support - genuine value, not the lowest sticker price.

items.q: Do you offer website maintenance and support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every project includes 30 days of free post-launch support for bugs and small changes. After that, we offer optional monthly maintenance retainers covering updates, security patches, backups, content changes and minor features, quoted to the size of your site.

items.q: Can you redesign or fix my existing slow website?
items.a: Absolutely. Website redesigns and performance rescues are a large part of our work. We audit your current site, identify what is hurting speed, SEO and conversions, then rebuild it on a modern stack. Most redesigns take 3-6 weeks and deliver dramatic improvements in Google PageSpeed and search rankings.

items.q: Do you provide web development services near me in Ahmedabad?
items.a: Yes. Our office is in Naranpura, Ahmedabad, and we serve clients across all Ahmedabad neighbourhoods - Bodakdev, SG Highway, Satellite, Prahlad Nagar, Naranpura, Maninagar, Vastrapur, Navrangpura, Bopal, Thaltej and more - plus Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot. You can meet us in person or work fully remotely; both are common.
